Curve.notes: Code Case explicitly directs use of TCD curve tcd-k-02. II-D source notes: Material Groups A-L use source Notes 1-12 (PDF pages 1236-1237). Group A matches the exact Nominal Composition label Carbon steel. Source Notes 9-11 restrict four compositions to 425 degC; maxTemperature on each identity enforces this limit in the reader. Note 9 prints 15Cr-5Ni-3Mo; retained as printed, not corrected to a different database composition. Note 10 explicitly permits separate S and Se compositions. Notes 10-12 also permit H/L/N/LN grades of austenitic stainless steels. Titanium grade/UNS identities are cross-referenced only from the explicit ASME TM-5 grade/UNS pairs, PDF page 1244. No numerical nominal composition is inferred from qualitative alloy labels or UNS.
